run: Modbus engine-off vs engine-on proof run
attack: FC16 multi-value misaligned firmware write, values [52, 53] to register 0x4000 (value 53 to reg 0x4001 is not 4-byte aligned) - GPL750-style Modbus register manipulation, CVE-2026-4436
target: Lab dummy Modbus target behind the live v3.1 gate on EC2 (ubuntu@ip-172-31-27-90, public IP 3.17.182.27)

legs.name: engine_off_attack_direct_to_target
legs.note: Attack frame echoed by the target. Ran immediately before leg 2 in the same terminal session. No gate log line: the frame bypassed the gate entirely, which is expected.

legs.name: engine_on_attack_through_gate
legs.note: Modbus exception 90 01. Gate log line at the same timestamp confirms the block.

legs.name: engine_on_legit_through_gate
legs.note: Legit write echoed by the target. Gate log line at the same timestamp confirms allowed.

gate_log_match: The 09:16:13 UTC log line records the leg 2 block; the 09:16:33 UTC line records the leg 3 allow. The three earlier lines in the excerpt (03:12-03:14 UTC) are prior allowed FC16 events, not part of this run.
